about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Prodeklarant — a customs brokerage company specialized in export.

intro.p1: Our main focus is to organize the export process safely, systematically and without hassle. We provide customs clearance, certification, contract preparation and transport documents for fruit, vegetable and other product exporters as a full package.
intro.p2: We don't just prepare documents — we manage the export process.

about.quote: We don't just prepare documents — we manage the export process.

approach.title: Our approach
approach.lead: Every export operation involves legal responsibility and financial risk. One incorrectly cleared document can lead to fines, lost time and contract issues. That is why we run every process:
items: in full compliance with current customs and currency legislation
approach.goal: Our goal is for the client to have peace of mind throughout the export process.

why.title: Why do clients choose us?
items: Full-service — no need to run to multiple agencies

about.quote: We value our clients' time and financial security. Every project is a special responsibility for us.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To simplify the international market activity of Uzbek exporters by providing them with safe, professional customs services.
mission.trust: We build trust through stable partnership, not one-off operations.

about.closing: Prodeklarant — your reliable representative at customs.
